data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 将环境生成变为终端任务，由提案智能体依据求解者 rollout 多轮生成新环境，成果进入下一轮训练，属持续自改进闭环。

scope_support.feedback_quote: A proposer agent builds new RL environments from the rollouts of the solver being trained, and the solver's new rollouts guide the next round.
scope_support.object_quote: treats environment design as a terminal task and uses agents to automate the data flywheel
scope_support.persistence_quote: by making both environment generation and solving terminal tasks, it lets one model co-evolve in both roles
